answer: Newcomers post a bond to enter the haven registry, held in escrow until three verified jobs clear. Cheat by forging attestations or double-claiming work and the bond is slashed: half to the victim, half burned. Vouching runs along a trellis: a veteran backing a sybil forfeits its own bond if the clone is caught. The kernel of the scheme: a fake identity costs more to keep staked than it could ever earn.
